content.value_statement: People miss follow-ups when dates, time zones, and reminder ownership are unclear. This skill creates and maintains precise reminders with optional links to relevant records.
actual_capabilities: Create one-time reminders for an exact date and local time.
Create daily, weekly, or monthly repeating reminders.
List reminders visible to the current user.
Update reminder text, timing, or repeating status.
Delete reminders or mark one-time reminders complete.
Link a reminder to a relevant workspace record.
limitations: It cannot guarantee delivery if the workspace notification system is unavailable.
It does not infer a time zone when the user has not provided enough context.
Public reminders notify the entire workspace and require an explicit request.
It does not replace a calendar, task manager, or escalation policy.

use_cases.title: Track Sales Follow-Ups
use_cases.description: Set a reminder after a customer conversation and link it to the matching account or opportunity record.

use_cases.title: Manage Team Commitments
use_cases.description: Create recurring reminders for reviews, approvals, and operational checks with clear local times.

use_cases.title: Protect Personal Tasks
use_cases.description: Keep private reminders for renewals, callbacks, and individual follow-ups without notifying the whole workspace.

prompt_templates.title: Create a One-Time Reminder
prompt_templates.prompt: Remind me to call Acme about the proposal next Friday at 9:00 AM in my local time zone.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Recurring Reminder
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a private reminder to review support escalations every Monday at 10:00 AM in my local time zone.

prompt_templates.title: Link a Follow-Up
prompt_templates.prompt: Remind me on 2026-12-05 at 2:00 PM to send the renewal summary, and link the reminder to the Acme account record.

prompt_templates.title: Maintain Existing Reminders
prompt_templates.prompt: List my reminders, move the quarterly review to the first business day of next month at 9:30 AM, and pause the weekly draft reminder.

output_examples.input: Remind me to review the Acme proposal next Friday at 9 AM.
output_examples.output: Reminder created for Friday, December 4, 2026 at 9:00 AM in your local time zone. It is private by default.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly reminder to check the renewal pipeline on the first day at 10 AM.
output_examples.output: Monthly reminder created for the first day of each month at 10:00 AM in your local time zone.

output_examples.input: Make the weekly planning reminder public.
output_examples.output: The reminder is now public and will notify everyone in the workspace.

best_practices: State the exact date, time, and time zone when a reminder matters.
Keep reminders private unless workspace-wide notification is required.
Link follow-ups to records so the next action has useful context.
anti_patterns: Do not make a reminder public when only one person needs it.
Do not use vague relative dates when a deadline is important.
Do not create duplicate recurring reminders for the same responsibility.

faq.question: Can I create repeating reminders?
faq.answer: Yes. You can create daily, weekly, or monthly reminders at a specified local time.

faq.question: Are reminders private?
faq.answer: Reminders are private by default. A public reminder notifies everyone in the workspace.

faq.question: Can I link a reminder to a record?
faq.answer: Yes. Link a reminder to a relevant record so the notification opens that record.

faq.question: What can I change after creating a reminder?
faq.answer: You can update its text or time, and you can pause a repeating reminder.

faq.question: Can I cancel a reminder?
faq.answer: Yes. Delete a reminder when it should no longer fire.

faq.question: Can I mark a reminder complete?
faq.answer: Yes. Complete a one-time reminder while keeping it in history as completed.
